svg.title: RWA tokenization lab architecture
svg.desc: Four bridge planks: custody, attestation, redemption and admission. Solid arrows show cash and shares; dashed arrows show calls, reports and off-chain steps.
svg.text: Solid arrows = USDC or tBILL movement | Dashed arrows = calls, checks, reports or off-chain steps
settle(): FIFO, fund cash, burn tBILL
Wiring: Vault + Queue have MINTER_ROLE; Queue is whitelisted; Vault.setQueue(queue); Vault has CUSTODIAN_ROLE.
Queue: full ticket or wait; shares burn at settlement. T+1 depends on cash arrival - there is no enforced one-day timer.
The queue reads NAV through the vault only at enqueue. A ticket keeps that payout when NAV changes later.
